story.headline: Apple's 37% gain came on quiet days: its nine flagged sessions netted a 6% loss, even as two quarters beat guidance.

chapters.title: iPhone 17 rally, then round trip
chapters.text: Early iPhone 17 data lifted the stock to a record; by 20 Jan it had round-tripped.

chapters.title: Two quarters above guidance
chapters.text: December and March quarters beat the company's growth guide; a further $100B buyback followed.

chapters.title: Memory costs catch up
chapters.text: Price hikes and a 9-11% September-quarter guide cost 13%; quiet-day gains in July offset most of it.

chapters.title: A record on quiet days
chapters.text: No flagged sessions: the stock rose to a record close with the market part roughly flat.
